items.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls dev apologises for PC "gameplay and performance issues"

Silent Hill producer Motoi Okamoto said the scriptwriters of Silent Hill f "pressured each other" to read "100 to 200 books a year", including those from f's writer Ryukishi07, to ensure they had a thorough understanding of the writer's "style and quirks".

Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 will release on 25th August 2026.

God of War Laufey will release on 16th February 2027.

items.title: Lara Croft can't catch a break: after delaying one Tomb Raider game, Amazon is delaying another and this one won't show up until 2028
items.description:
Lara Croft's big comeback at the hands of Amazon has hit yet another hitch. After TV show setbacks and a delay for Tomb Raider 1 "reimagining" Legacy of Atlantis, Amazon's gaming boss has confirmed yet another delay: Lara's other adventure, Tomb Raider: Catalyst, now won't arrive until some time in 2028.

Read more

items.title: It looks like we're getting a Halo 2 remake next, but is that really a surprise?
items.description:
Halo has a proud history of smuggling secret endings into its campaigns. In the very first 2001 game, there is a hidden (non-canon) ending featuring Sgt. Avery Johnson fighting and hugging an Elite. In Halo 2, there's a mid-credits scene that teases the beginning of Halo 3. In Halo 3, we get a full scene of Chief drifting, alone, in the cold, indifferent vacuum of space. ODST gives us a glimpse of the Engineers' secret. And in Reach, my personal favourite, we get that phenomenal 'Lone Wolf' ending that still sends shivers down my spine to think about today.

Read more

items.title: Amid the recent Xbox devastation, Microsoft is seemingly uncancelling something, which is good news for Age of Empires 3 fans at least
items.description:
Here's something you don't hear very often, especially in a month as destructive as the one Xbox is having: Microsoft is seemingly uncancelling something; specifically its previously announced and then subsequently abandoned Age of Empires 3 DLC, which is now set to arrive this September.

Read more
category: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition

items.title: A new Guild Wars 3 blog post spills the beans on the game's narrative focus, and perhaps even how magic will work in the upcoming MMORPG
items.description:
A new blog post has been released from ArenaNet, detailing some interesting story details for its upcoming MMORPG Guild Wars 3. However, present within the text might just be a hint to two into how magic will work in-game.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation Network down, as tens of thousands of players queue to play Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls newly-launched beta
items.description:
Reports of a PlayStation Network (PSN) outage are currently spiking, as many players are struggling to connect to online services.

Read more

items.title: There's a Breakout movie on the way as Atari signs deal to bring Pong, Asteroids, and other classic games to the big screen
items.description:
In a surefire sign Hollywood has reached the desperation stage of its insatiable hunger for video game properties to swallow up and spit out in dubiously recognisable big-screen form, Atari has somewhat improbably announced a deal with Universal Pictures to produce ten movies based on classic retro games from its expansive backcatalogue, including Pong, Breakout, and more.

Read more

items.title: Kingdom Come Salvation may be the next Medieval RPG from Warhorse, and it could have some sort of multi-player functionality, too
items.description:
It looks like we've had our first hint as to what we can expect next from the Kingdom Come studio, Warhorse. We only heard back in May this year that a third Kingdom Come RPG may be released sooner than we expected, and it seems like the barely-announced title already has a name.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft boss Yves Guillemot doesn't believe PlayStation ditching physical discs will "disturb" the industry much
items.description:
Ubisoft CEO Yves Guillemot has chimed in on the debate surrounding Sony's planned shift away from physical disc production, stating he doesn't think it will "disturb" the industry too much.

Read more

items.title: "We still value the culture of physical media" As PlayStation prepares for an all-digital future, Sega president comes out in support of discs
items.description:
Sega is the latest publisher to make its views about physical media clear, in the wake of Sony's controversial decision to kill off the manufacture and sale of discs by 2028. The president of the Japanese publisher, Shuji Utsumi, noted that he believes physical media is still important, though digital distribution is "crucial", mostly thanks to the "steadily increasing" number of people playing on PC.

Read more

items.title: If PlayStation kills physical media, it should "get rid of the hardware" too, says the creator of popular RPG series Disgaea
items.description:
Since 1st July, when Sony announced its intent to move away from the production and sale of physical media, we've seen plenty of backlash from both consumers and those working within the video game industry. There's plenty of evidence of this, but the most vocal and visceral has come from comments on pretty much anything Sony has posted online in the days since the announcement.

Read more

items.title: Xbox rolls out ad-supported game streaming test for its insider programs, as hardware supply and affordability crisis rages on
items.description:
Xbox has announced a test for an ad-supporting streaming service for its Xbox Insider program. It will allow players to stream select games from their library for free for one-hour sessions, with advertisements playing before play sessions.

Read more

items.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced has already sold over 3.5 million copies, "exceeding annual expectations within its first 14 days"
items.description:
Assassin's Creed Black Flag is going from strength-to-strength for Ubisoft. After netting 2m sales in its opening few days (and then ascending to 3m within a week), Ubisoft has just announced that the game has sold through an impressive 3.5m units - meaning the remake has "exceeded annual expectations within its first 14 days", per a new financial report from the publisher.

Read more

items.title: As layoff controversy continues, Rockstar union has 'more members than ever before', meaning it could force mandatory recognition
items.description:
The Rockstar Game Workers Union (RGWU), which was formed earlier this year in response to the Grand Theft Auto 6 developer's massively controversial job cuts, now has "more members than it ever had before".

Read more

items.title: Former Disney CEO Michael Eisner can't remember why he green-lit Kingdom Hearts
items.description:
Kingdom Hearts might be beloved by millions of players around the world, but it apparently didn't have a lasting impact on arguably one of the most important people involved in its creation: former Walt Disney CEO Michael Eisner has admitted he can't remember why he approved the pitch for Square Enix's legendary video game series.

Read more

items.title: Steam's latest update finally brings order to the chaos of your wishlist, and might even nudge people into buying you some new games
items.description:
If you're among the millions whose Steam wishlists have been accumulating games for years, and you're too scared to venture in, Valve's latest Steam update should help.

items.title: EU approves Saudi Arabia's $55bn acquisition of EA, clearing path for largest private leveraged buyout of all time
items.description:
The European Union has approved the controversial $55bn acquisition of Electronic Arts by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), private equity company Silver Lake, and investment company Affinity Partners.

Read more

items.title: Resident Evil movie gets another spooky trailer, and features a fun game reference for keen-eyed fans

A new trailer for the upcoming Resident Evil movie has been released, introducing the call-to-action for our protagonist's journey into the dark and spooky world of bio terror. It also features a nice little easter egg for keen-eyed fans of the games.

items.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 will very soon offer three different matchmaking systems, and you'd be right to be confused
items.description:

items.title: "The smallest severance pay possible" - Bethesda union vows to fight as studio employees reel from "bare minimum" payout following mass Xbox layoffs
items.description:
Following Xbox mass layoffs earlier this month, employees at Bethesda's Montréal studio have reportedly been told they'll receive the "smallest" severance pay legally possible.

items.title: After its Baldur's Gate 3-era splurge, Hasbro is scaling back its gaming ambitions following $56m loss, but Warlock and Mass Effect-like Exodus are safe
items.description:
Hasbro, the parent company of Dungeons and Dragons owner Wizards of the Coast, is seemingly scaling back its video game ambitions. The company, which had initiated a plan in 2022 to become a major publisher, has already cancelled several of its projects and laid off many of their developers.

items.title: Xbox version of Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game delayed by over a month, less than 24 hours before launch
items.description:
Less than 24 hours before its intended release date, the developers behind the Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game have announced some serious disruptions to the launch on Xbox and Nintendo Switch.

items.title: Stalker 2 developer refutes claims by studio founder that Xbox paid more than game's development cost to make it exclusive

Earlier this week, GSC Game World studio founder Sergiy Grygorovych made a bombshell revelation about the development of Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl. Grygorovych said in an interview with YouTuber OLDboi that Microsoft paid a significant sum to keep the then-upcoming open-world shooter a timed Xbox exclusive.

Read more

items.title: Following layoffs and muddy strategy shifts, Xbox announces Backward Compatibility on PC program, with Blinx and Conker leading the first wave
items.description:
As Microsoft tries to downplay the effects on its gaming business of cutting 3,200 jobs and four studios, Xbox is rethinking its whole strategy even if the more recent comments from inside the house still sound confused at best. Don't worry though; old Xbox games are coming to PC.

items.title: Splatoon Raiders developers reveal it originally was "like a base defence game" before evolving into a faster spin-off "with a strong sense of action"
items.description:
Splatoon Raiders will attempt to make a splash tomorrow, 23rd July, and Nintendo is celebrating its launch on Switch 2 with a surprisingly in-depth chat with four key Nintendo EPD developers.

Read more

items.title: Of all the platforms, Xbox is the only one to have just grown year-on-year - but there's a big catch
items.description:
Market analysis firm Circana has published the latest edition of its monthly report, which tracks spending across game hardware and software in the US. June's edition is another bleak one, with a near-universal decline.

Read more

items.title: Palworld has sold over 30m copies already, with Steam unsurprisingly emerging as the most popular platform
items.description:
Palworld's 1.0 release has been massive so far, with the game hitting its biggest concurrent player peaks since the 2024 early access launch for the past two weeks. Unsurprisingly, that has also translated into a boost to premium unit sales.

Read more

items.title: Sony's decision to kill off PlayStation discs could destroy the $7.2bn used game market, according to analysts
items.description:
The second-hand video game market stands in jeopardy in the wake of Sony's decision to end the manufacturing of PlayStation discs by January 2028. The market, which analysts estimate is worth $7.2bn globally, could be destroyed as a result of Sony's controversial move.

Read more

items.title: Here's your next batch of Xbox Game Pass games for July
items.description:
Xbox has revealed the next batch of games coming to its Xbox Game Pass subscription service during the remainder of July and in early August, with Halo: Campaign Evolved and Hell Is Us spearheading the selection.

Read more

items.title: Asha Sharma-appointed Xbox VP of engineering leaves just three months after moving over from Microsoft's CoreAI team
items.description:
When Microsoft assigned Asha Sharma as the new leader of the Xbox division in February, replacing the Phil Spencer regime, the executive brought along some of her former colleagues with her. Now, one of those recent hires is leaving.

Read more

items.title: Reddit is forcing Google AI into hallucinating The Duskbloods characters before FromSoftware's Switch 2 exclusive is even out
items.description:
The Duskbloods' first playtest - which will likely mark the first time anyone outside FromSoftware and Nintendo has played the Switch 2 exclusive - is coming next month, yet Google's AI search believes the subreddit r/TheDuskbloods already has official information.

Read more

items.title: Mortal Shell 2 sells out of physical Revered Edition PS5 pre-orders as players rush to buy the highly-anticipated game on disc
items.description:
With a little under one month left until the launch of Soulslike Mortal Shell 2, one of the game's physical versions can no longer be pre-ordered. Stock of the £55 ($70) PlayStation 5 Revered Edition is completely depleted, publisher Playstack announced.

Read more

items.title: Darkest Dungeon is getting its first dollop of DLC in several years, as the gloomy old RPG celebrates its 10th birthday
items.description:
Darkest Dungeon 2 landed well enough and received generally positive reviews, but it's never been universally accepted in the same way the original game was, as Steam user reviews of Darkest Dungeon 2 highlight. Now, developer Red Hook Studios is surprising fans with a return to the original game.

Read more

items.title: Jagex wants classic British point-and-click MMO RuneScape to be bigger than World of Warcraft
items.description:
Jagex CEO Jon Bellamy has shared his lofty aspiration for RuneScape to be the biggest MMO in the world in the next five years. That, for those unaware, would mean toppling World of Warcraft from the top spot.

items.title: The FBI has arrested a 21-year-old alleged to have stolen $220,000 through Steam using malware-ridden games
items.description:
The FBI has arrested a 21-year-old Florida man alleged to have stolen roughly $220,000 of crypto currency using malware installed alongside games. And while the PC platform used to nab this catch isn't explicitly specified, the infested games listed by the FBI were present on Steam until recently.

Read more

items.title: Slay the Spire 2 developer shows artwork and concepts for Doormaker boss replacement Aeonglass
items.description:
Last month, Slay the Spire 2's Act 3 boss Doormaker - the third in a series of late-game reworks - was removed and replaced by Aeonglass. Now, developer Mega Crit has revealed how its fun visual design came to be.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo has no obligation to pass tariff refunds onto customers, the company says, because Switch buyers received "what they bargained and paid for"
items.description:
Nintendo has said it does not owe people who bought its products at higher prices any rebates, after the company raised prices in response to inflated US tariffs. The Japanese gaming giant is seeking the dismissal of a class-action lawsuit that argues this exact case: that consumers deserve a portion of the refund Nintendo could receive from the US government.

Read more

items.title: Xbox Game Pass was a good idea in theory, former Forza Horizon 5 director says, but "the reality is not enough people have subscribed"
items.description:
Mike Brown, ex-director on Forza Horizon 5 at Playground Games, has commented on Xbox's current problems and Game Pass' impact on the brand's overarching strategy in recent years.

Read more

items.title: Once you see it, you can't unsee it: Hilarity ensues as new DC Comics fighting game is named DCKO
items.description:
A new fighting game has been announced! Making use of the rich DC universe, this upcoming release brings free-to-play 2v2 brawling to mobile. Its name? Um, DCKO.

items.title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic remake might be re-revealed this year, a new report suggests
items.description:
The on-again, off-again Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic remake - which was first announced in late 2021 before changing studios - may be re-revealed as soon as this year.

category: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Remake

items.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands appears to be getting a PS5 and Xbox Series X/S Definitive Edition, but is it a remaster or a bog standard re-release?
items.description:
If you've been itching to replay Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands, for some reason, you may soon have a reason to. The open-world co-op shooter will be 10 years old next March and it looks like Ubisoft is celebrating the anniversary early.

items.title: The next major moment for Marathon arrives today with a new update and the debut of its PvE mode, Vault Breaker
items.description:
Bungie has shown off Vault Breaker in a new gameplay trailer. This is Marathon's experimental, time-limited PvE mode, which arrives today in Season 2's mid-season update. Vault Breaker is a roguelite mode that exists separately from the normal modes. In other words, it's not simply a PvE toggle you can turn on across the game.

Read more

items.title: Xbox admits its game exclusivity strategy isn't "obvious", but insists Gears of War and Clockwork Revolution won't be the only non-PlayStation games
items.description:
Another day, another update on what's happening over at Xbox after last month's showcase and the subsequent cuts of 3,200 jobs and studio divestments. The matter at hand today: console exclusives, and based on past comments by Xbox, we don't really know what to expect or what's going on.

Read more

items.title: Despite outrage at Sony's shift towards a discless future, only seven PlayStation games have managed more than 100,000 physical sales in the US this year
items.description:
Sony's planned shift away from producing physical discs for PlayStation might be unpopular, but new sales data has highlighted the stark business reality behind it.

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 open and closed beta dates announced, including for Switch 2, alongside the return of Call of Duty: Next
items.description:
Activision has finally revealed some worthwhile new details about what the next few months will look like in the lead-up to the release of Modern Warfare 4. The company officially announced the return of Call of Duty: Next, the event that has, for the last several years, served as the home for the debut of multiplayer gameplay.

Read more

items.title: After Doom director Hugo Martin denied reports that id Software had been gutted, "current and former employees" are disagreeing with his optimism
items.description:
It's been two weeks since Microsoft announced 3,200 layoffs and sweeping cuts hit the Xbox division. Not even well-established institutions like Doom and Quake studio id Software were safe - with the first reports painting a very bleak picture - yet Hugo Martin, director on the latest Doom entries, pushed back against claims the iconic FPS developer had been turned into little more than a support studio. A few days later, "current and former employees" are saying they aren't as optimistic as Martin.

Read more

items.title: A religious war is raging right now, as people are dressing in robes and rushing into danger in Old School RuneScape
items.description:
Do you ever get a hankering to bust out the fancy robes, grab a staff, and venture out into the wild with a gaggle of your friends? Well, good news! Religious war is back in a big way, in Old School RuneScape.

items.title: Ever wanted to play The Elder Scrolls: Morrowind on a dual-screen handheld? Well, now you can - if you don't mind putting in some legwork
items.description:
The Elder Scrolls 6 isn't anywhere near done, and you might be getting tired of replaying Skyrim and Oblivion over and over again across several platforms. But don't worry, as the Elder Scrolls community has now cracked a surprising way to replay Morrowind.

items.title: Save-game carry-overs and time-leaping sequels: medieval vampire RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker has some bold ideas for the future
items.description:
It's Mass Effect all over again, maybe. You'll be able to carry your save from The Blood of Dawnwalker into future Dawnwalker games, developer Rebel Wolves and publisher Bandai Namco have confirmed.

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 gameplay debut reignites community debate about how fast Call of Duty movement should be
items.description:
Our first look at Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer gameplay arrived, not as part of a Call of Duty: Next event, as is tradition, but through a handful of livestreams from a select few who got to play the game at Fanatics Fest NYC, which took place 16th-19th July.

Read more

items.title: EA Sports FC simulations correctly predicted the FIFA World Cup winner would be Spain, and it's not the first time it has happened
items.description:
Spain is the new FIFA World Cup winner after defeating Argentina one to zero last night, and once again, the EA Sports FC game correctly predicted the result in advance.

Read more

items.title: UK games retailer Game entered administration owing £16m, thanks to fierce competition, consumer trends, and "uncertainty associated with Brexit"
items.description:
Insight into the fall of British high street video game retailer Game going into administration has been brought to light in a new report. After years of business troubles and challenges, this write-up claims the company's liquidation was caused by changing consumer behaviour, fierce competition, and "uncertainty associated with Brexit".

Read more

items.title: "Honestly, it's still getting worse" - Valve Steam Machine engineer says component prices are still rising, potentially paving the way for a price increase
items.description:
There is no end seemingly in sight for the memory crisis, or of how much higher the price of consumer electronics could go. Valve, which recently shipped its expensive Steam Machine, has learned this the hard way.

Read more

items.title: "Professional lurker" Todd Howard reappears on internet forums following Bethesda's Fallout and Elder Scrolls announcements to thank fans for their support
items.description:
Following sweeping layoffs across the entire Xbox division earlier this month, Bethesda shared a surprisingly transparent roadmap about the Fallout and The Elder Scrolls projects it's making. Now, Bethesda Game Studios leader Todd Howard has returned to Reddit after a six-month hiatus to thank fans for their support.

Read more

items.title: "The Gears of War trilogy was largely developed hungover by me" - Cliff Bleszinski reckons with a difficult past while plotting a return to games and a brighter future
items.description:
Cliff Bleszkinski, the designer instrumental in the creation of Gears of War - the face of the series for three games - has opened up about a career-long struggle with alcohol which he's now reckoning with, while also teasing a potential return to creating games.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty voice chat lobbies turned into ASMR app that takes veterans back to the cacophonies of the MW2 and BO1 days
items.description:
Whereas some people fall asleep to white noise or calm soundscapes, others can apparently do so while in the middle of noisy online matches. At least, that's what one app developer who was nostalgic for the olden Call of Duty days seems to think, as they have shaken the ASMR scene up with a lobby voice chat 'ambience' website.

items.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced sold 3 million in its first week
items.description:

Footage of the cancelled Kingdom Hearts Missing-Link has appeared online, just over a year since development on the game ended.

Palworld is once again one of the most played games on Steam this weekend.

Marathon director Joe Ziegler has left Bungie after three and a half years at the studio.

ZA/UM Studio, the contentious developer at the heart of years of bitter public and legal disputes since the release of 2019's acclaimed Disco Elysium, is to lay off up to 32 staff members "across all departments", it's been announced.

Promising new medieval vampire role-playing game The Blood of Dawnwalker will be, hallelujah, released on a good old fashioned disc.

items.title: Not so much James Bond, more Mission Impossible - 007 First Light was originally more of an ensemble piece, says IO Interactive

IO Interactive once considered making 007 First Light more of an ensemble piece than it turned out to be. In other words, the game would have been less about James Bond on his own and more about him and a team of agents working together.

items.title: "I feel totally unbothered" - Deborah Ann Woll doesn't care about the trolls taking shots at God Of War Laufey
items.description:
Since it was announced at the beginning of June, God of War Laufey has been receiving an unexpected amount of negative criticism. And a lot of the commentary about the game - of which we've only seen one trailer so far - revolves around the actress playing the eponymous character Laufey in it: Deborah Ann Woll, who reprises the role from God of War (2018).

items.title: Battlefield 6 is getting an evolved Carrier Assault mode in Season 4, and the Top Gun collab brings more than cosmetics
items.description:
Battlefield 6's upcoming Season 4 continues to look like one of its most exciting seasons yet. After delivering a first look at naval combat earlier this week, Battlefield Studios has now detailed more of what we can expect throughout the season, including early details on the teased Top Gun collaboration.

items.title: Bethesda reassures fans The Elder Scrolls 6 is "on the way" following the Xbox cuts, and that it's "loving how it looks" and "playing it every day"

Bethesda Game Studios has moved to calm concerns about The Elder Scrolls 6 following recent Xbox cuts, telling players that, "The next chapter is on the way. We're where we planned to be, loving how it looks, and playing it every day."

items.title: Starfield "remains an important part of our future" says Bethesda, as developer pledges continued support for sci-fi RPG

Bethesda has confirmed that its spacefaring sci-fi RPG Starfield will continue to be supported by the developer, even after suffering layoffs and has refocused on core franchises like The Elder Scrolls and Fallout.

items.title: Those rumoured Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas remasters are real, Fallout 5 is in pre-production, and Fallout 76 is getting a massive expansion

In the statement, the company noted that those long-rumoured Fallout: New Vegas and Fallout 3 remasters are indeed real, teased a mystery Fallout project being developed with Obsidian, and - last but not least - announced that Fallout 5 is now in preproduction.

items.title: Star Wars: KOTOR remake is alive and eyeing a 2028 release window, according to Sabre Interactive's chief business office

It's no secret that the Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (KOTOR) Remake has had its share of development woes, leaving many in dismay as one of the best Star Wars games of all time may never get its deserved polish-up. However, a recent message from Sabre Interactive's new chief business officer might offer a new hope (sorry).

category: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Remake

items.title: Claims about GTA 6 pre-orders are incorrect and "absurd", analyst firm says, but it's still had the "strongest pre-order campaign ever recorded"

It sounds as though EA's being careful, for now, about which brands can advertise in its games.

Read more

items.title: "It's not that we don't care about PC" - Former Rockstar developer suggests why GTA 6 is only coming to consoles at launch
items.description:
GTA 6 is looming like that monolith in 2001: A Space Odyssey, casting its fearsome shadow over the games industry and probably also scaring some monkeys. But PC players won't be able to join in the fun when Rockstar Games' mega-sequel launches on 19th November, and former studio producer John Ricchio - who worked on the likes of GTA 5, Red Dead Redemption, and Max Payne 3 - has shared some insight into why that may be.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft is working on Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced New Game Plus
items.description:
The massive success of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced probably has something to do with the studio's decision to work on a New Game Plus mode. Game director Richard Knight confirmed the feature is currently in early stages of development.

Read more

items.title: Here are our PS Plus Premium and Extra games for July
items.description:
We're in the midst of a scorching summer. And for this season of staying inside and sweating it out, PlayStation Plus' July line-up is bringing a new batch of games to keep us entertained while the sun is out, making touching grass more arduous than usual.

Read more

items.title: Zenimax Online Studios leadership included in widespread Xbox job cuts, as concerns around Elder Scrolls Online's longevity persist
items.description:
Multiple members of Zenimax Online Studios' senior leadership are being cut from the company, as part of sweeping Xbox layoffs that have resulted in over 200 redundancies from the Elder Scrolls Online developer.

Read more

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 offers first look at Kill Block ahead of multiplayer gameplay debut this week
items.description:
Infinity Ward has dropped a brief teaser of Modern Warfare 4's Kill Block. This is a new type of multiplayer experience for Call of Duty, an ever-changing arena that's assembled from hundreds of different map variations. Think of it like a procedurally generated small map.

Read more

items.title: League of Legends Classic players clash against old-school skin cosmetics, as the faithfulness of the new game mode is called into question
items.description:
League of Legends Classic has been revealed in earnest by Riot Games. A recreation of an older MOBA experience, League Classic is taking core moments from the early seasons and merging them together, though some players are already raising eyebrows at one aspect: the champion skins.

Read more

items.title: The Duskbloods' promised playtest is happening next month on Switch 2, and it sure looks like getting in will be hard
items.description:
The lack of news on The Duskbloods - finally ended by June's Nintendo Direct announcement of a playtest - has kept the hype for FromSoftware's next game at bay for now, but that could change as soon as next month, when players finally get a taste of what the studio has been cooking.

Read more

items.title: GoldenEye-inspired FPS Agent 64: Spies Never Die finally locks a release date, and it's not far away
items.description:
In this day and age, many indie games use "Remember the thing?" as their main hook even if the nostalgia-fuelled gameplay ends up feeling miserable, and while the GoldenEye-inspired FPS Agent 64: Spies Never Die wears its influences proudly, there's more to it based on my time with its Steam demo. Soon, we'll be able to play the full thing.

Read more

items.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced studio Ubisoft Barcelona goes on three-day strike in protest of layoffs
items.description:
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is off to a roaring start, with Ubisoft trumpeting 2m copies sold on launch day alone. But despite its success, Ubisoft Barcelona - one of the studios involved in its development - is still facing layoffs, and workers are currently staging a three-day strike in protest.

Read more

items.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced enjoys the best launch of any AC game on Steam, making avast sum of money there
items.description:
It's clear by now that Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced has been a success for Ubisoft, even though that's inexplicably resulted in the publisher laying off many of the developers that made it possible. A tally of 2m copies sold on launch day is an impressive number, and new data underlines just how big the launch has actually been on Steam.

Read more

items.title: Dead Space series co-creator and industry veteran Glen Schofield announces his retirement in emotional video
items.description:
Glen Schofield, the former co-founder of Sledgehammer Games and co-creator of Dead Space, has announced his retirement from game development. Schofield broke the news in an emotional video on his LinkedIn page, in which he recalled a storied career helping bring iconic games to life and working alongside many talented people for over 35 years.

Read more

items.title: "I don't know how anyone remaining at Xbox Studios can feel safe" - New report reveals environment of uncertainty and fear, and a "staggering" loss of institutional knowledge
items.description:
A new report based on testimonies of people affected by Microsoft's recent cuts to the Xbox division has painted a picture of secrecy, disarray and anger, and of a company left reeling as further layoffs loom.

Read more

items.title: The rumoured Resident Evil 1 Remake reportedly entered pre-production last year
items.description:
The rumoured Resident Evil 1 Remake is back in the news again, thanks to new information from a longtime insider. Dusk Golem, a noted horror game and Resident Evil leaker, shared an update on their social media about the state of the project.

Read more

items.title: According to a poll, Generative AI is being used by a whopping 100% of Japanese online game developers, as copyright infringement concerns climb
items.description:
A new report on the Japanese Online game industry has shown that 100 percent of polled developers are currently using generative AI.

Read more

items.title: Battlefield 6 is bringing back a feature we've not seen since Battlefield 2, and teasing a fitting Top Gun collab alongside it
items.description:
Battlefield Studios has released our first look at Season 4 in Battlefield 6. This new trailer arrives a week ahead of Season 4's launch on 21st July, and shows plenty to be excited about.

Read more

items.title: Marvel Rivals players are airing their frustrations over Season 9's excessive "visual clutter" and other issues making it difficult to enjoy
items.description:
Marvel Rivals has only been around for 18 months or so, but already we've reached Season 9. And with it comes a narrative arc focusing on Marvel characters like Apocalypse, perfectly timed to coincide with X-Men '97's season two. Marvel's Rivals also welcomed fireworks-throwing mutant Jubilee a few days ago, and while many players are digging the new hero, the update that introduced her has been heavily criticised by fans.

Read more
